revoke.title: Revoke the invitation to {{name}}?
revoke.description: The link will stop working. You can invite them again whenever you want.

revoke-sessions.title: Close sessions for {{name}}?
revoke-sessions.description: They must sign in again on every device, personally and in their organizations. Nothing else changes.

suspend.title: Suspend the account for {{name}}?
suspend.description: They cannot sign in personally or in their organizations, and sessions on both sides are closed. Their organizations continue working for the other members.

reactivate.title: Reactivate the account for {{name}}?
reactivate.description: They can sign in personally and in their organizations again, with the same roles.

deletion.title: Delete the account for {{name}}?
deletion.description: Their sessions are closed and they are notified through all their sign-in methods. They have 30 days to cancel by signing in; the account is deleted afterwards. The platform cannot cancel it.
deletion.soleOwner: They are the only Owner of {{organization}}. The organization must add another Owner first, or the platform must close it.
